title: 第19章 深入断牙山第20章 幼虎
content_zh:
;;
断牙山。
层峦叠翠，雾霭缭绕。
高逾千丈，因其峰顶裂成两瓣，恰似巨兽咬碎的断齿得名。
远远望去，如同一只蛰伏在云海中的洪荒凶兽。
十里八乡的山林田地都是依赖着断牙山而存，即便不断有乡民开拓山林，但依旧只占据其很小的一部分。
断牙山深处，多是各类猛兽，成群结队。
即便一流武者都不敢保证自己可以横穿整座断牙山。
因为，传闻这里生存着开了灵智的妖兽。
此时，一道藏青色身影如猿猴般在茂密山林间跳跃，身形无比灵活。
每一次换位置，都会惊起一阵鸟雀。
此人正是许明巍，背着两张弓，一张是黑铁大弓，另一张是松涛色长弓
黑铁大弓是特制的强弓。
单单拉开就要上千斤的力道，想要拉成满月状，更是要三千斤以上。
一流武者才能凭借单纯力道拉至满月。
只有周天穴窍贯通的后天巅峰武者，才能游刃有余，随心所欲。
用这把弓射出的箭矢，追云逐电，有千钧之势。
哪怕是初入先天的武者，被寻到机会，也能一箭重伤。
至于许明巍，【天生神力】如今赋予他单臂四千两百斤的力道，再加上【鹰眼】的天赋，可以锁定目标。
被他抓住机会，可不仅仅是重伤那么简单了。

绝对是一击必杀！
另一把松涛色的长弓就普通多了，不过猎杀寻常猛虎恶狼也是绰绰有余。
唯有对付一些异兽，许明巍才会动用黑铁强弓。
此地已越过黎庶们开垦的最边缘山林田地十几里。
各村猎户都不会闯入如此深。
“上次差不多就到这里了。”
许明巍又移动了几个方位，最后在一株大树的树干上发现了自己用匕首刻下的痕迹。
那是一个‘许’字。
入木三分，笔走蛇龙，颇具一种豪迈气势。
许川要求许家子弟，每日练字必须到十五岁方可停止。
十年苦练。
练字亦是炼心。
许明巍也是最近才发现这个道理，心中对于许川越加的佩服。
故而他还是会经常练习，以彰其志。
“雪霁要的小动物，就等回去时再顺带找找看吧。”
许明巍看了看四周，继续快速深入。
相比较在地面奔走，在树上跳跃，要安全许多。
突然间。
他身侧传来“嗖”的破空声，就见一个拳头大的物体朝他脑袋砸去。
content_en:
;;
Broken Tooth Mountain.
There are layers of greenery and mist.
More than a thousand feet high, it got its name because its peak split into two pieces, just like the broken teeth of a giant beast.
Looking from a distance, it looks like a wild beast dormant in the sea of ​​clouds.
The mountains, forests and fields in the ten miles and eight villages depend on Duanya Mountain for their existence. Even though villagers continue to open up the mountains and forests, they still occupy only a small part of it.
Deep in the Broken Ya Mountain, there are many kinds of ferocious beasts, swarming in groups.
Even top-notch warriors cannot guarantee that they can cross the entire Broken Tooth Mountain.
Because it is said that there are monsters with spiritual intelligence living here.
At this time, a navy blue figure jumped like an ape in the dense mountain forest, with an extremely flexible body.
Every time I changed my position, I would startle a flock of birds.
This person is Xu Mingwei, carrying two bows, one is a large black iron bow, and the other is a pine-colored long bow.
The black iron bow is a specially made strong bow.
Just to pull it open requires a force of over a thousand kilograms, and to pull it into a full moon shape requires more than three thousand kilograms.
Only a top-notch warrior can reach the full moon with sheer force.
Only the acquired peak martial artist who has thorough access to the Zhoutian acupoints can do whatever he wants with ease.
The arrows shot from this bow can chase clouds and lightning with great power.
Even a first-time Xiantian warrior can be seriously injured by an arrow if given an opportunity.
As for Xu Mingwei, [Innate Divine Power] now gives him a strength of 4,200 kilograms in one arm. Coupled with the talent of [Eagle Eye], he can lock targets.
If he seizes the opportunity, it's not just as simple as being seriously injured.
Definitely a one-hit kill!
The other pine-colored longbow is much more ordinary, but it is more than enough to hunt ordinary tigers and wolves.
Xu Mingwei would only use the black iron bow to deal with some strange beasts.
This place is more than ten miles beyond the edge of the mountains and forests cultivated by the common people.
No hunter from any village would penetrate so deeply.
"That's almost the end of it last time."
Xu Mingwei moved a few more positions, and finally found the mark he had carved with his dagger on the trunk of a big tree.
That is the word "Xu".
Penetrating into the wood three points, the pen moves like a snake or a dragon, giving it a rather heroic aura.
Xu Chuan requires the children of the Xu family to practice calligraphy every day until they are fifteen years old.
Ten years of hard training.
Practicing calligraphy is also training the mind.
Xu Mingwei only discovered this truth recently, and he admired Xu Chuan even more.
Therefore, he will still practice frequently to show his ambition.
"Let's look for the little animals that Xue Ji wants when we go back."
Xu Mingwei looked around and continued to dive in quickly.
Compared to running on the ground and jumping in trees, it is much safer.
suddenly.
There was a "whoosh" sound piercing the air beside him, and an object as big as a fist hit his head.
